resolution: Exact-file override, otherwise longest directory prefix. Append unmatched suffix. Hold/split_required have no executable destination.
runtime_override: Only ignored non-source payloads under a registered tau2 edition with category benchmark_definition are proposed under artifacts/benchmarks/tau2/<edition>/legacy/<relative path>. Inspect the compressed file inventory for exact rows; this is not an executable migration script.
frozen_policy: Preserve original bytes and manifests; path changes require explicit mapping or a separate historical checkout, never rewriting old hashes to pass.
collision_policy: Any target collision blocks execution; no overwrite or deduplication is authorized.
